root.label: Javier Milei attacks Pope Francis during 2023 campaign

events.label: Javier Milei attacks Pope Francis during 2023 campaign

slots.name: campaign year
slots.sentence: Sociologist and political scientist Ariel Goldstein told UPI that tensions between Milei and the church date back to the 2023 presidential campaign, when the then-candidate repeatedly attacked Pope Francis, calling him "the representative of the evil one on Earth" and linking him to communism.
